text:
ravi (Partnerships): Heads-up team : Polaris Analytics added Redwood Private as an optional addon in their managed analytics appliance listing. Pilot kicks off next week  big expansion potential :tada:

cleo (Sales): Love it. Any pilot commitment numbers we should track?

ravi (Partnerships): 3-month pilot, 20 appliances initially, target to scale to 200 across their enterprise customers if perf looks good. Billing is consumption + small integration fee.

maya (Partner Success): I'll own onboarding and need an integration checklist, SSO/SAML guidance, and a short troubleshooting FAQ for their infra team. Also request a private channel with Polaris infra leads.

zane (Eng): Noted. Tech asks: sample Helm values for the connector, token rotation example, and recommended resource requests for the sidecar agent. Quick enroll curl to share:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/enroll \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ENROLL_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{"appliance_id":"polaris-node-01"}'
```
We'll call back to api.redwood.ai over TLS and expect outbound port 443. Agent also exposes 8443 for local health checks.

market-sync-bot: marketplace build 2030-06-12T10:12:02Z - validation: PASS

hannah (Marketing): Great — can we capture a 1-line quote at kickoff and a simple architecture diagram? Recommend holding public case study until after pilot month 1 metrics.

cleo (Sales): Marking CRM opp as "Marketplace Addon Pilot" and tagging AE for renewal playbook. Adding revenue motion for node expansion >50.

ravi (Partnerships): Created `#polaris-redwood-integration` private channel and invited core team + Polaris infra lead. I'll send a draft marketplace blurb to review: 
"Polaris Analytics and Redwood Inference deliver integrated, low-latency model serving bundled with Polariss managed analytics appliance for enterprise deployments."

hannah (Marketing): Tiny edit: replace "model serving" with "LLM inference" and add "SSO & cert rotation supported" if we have space.

ravi (Partnerships): Updated blurb: 
"Polaris Analytics and Redwood Inference deliver integrated, low-latency LLM inference bundled with Polaris managed analytics appliance for enterprise deployments. Supports SSO and certificate rotation for secure operations."

maya (Partner Success): I'll capture the quote during kickoff and collect an initial success metric snapshot in week 1. Also requesting a short runbook for cert rotation for long-lived appliances.

zane (Eng): Will drop Helm values and a minimal values.yaml in the private channel by EOD, plus a sample `values.agent.resources` recommendation.

hannah (Marketing): I'll draft the partner one-pager and a short blog outline for internal review. Will wait for week-1 telemetry before external assets.

ravi (Partnerships): Solid. Next steps: (1) zane: helm values + token rotation example by EOD, (2) maya: kickoff + quote, (3) hannah: draft collateral next Tue. Huge team effort  thanks all! :rocket:
